text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, I'm so excited! I can't wait for the Japan Cup to start!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: The lineup is too impressive! There's the Beast, Oguri Cap, then there's White Lightning, Tamamo Cross!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Hey, you're forgetting someone important!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: The prettiest Umamusume of this generation, Gold City! She'll definitely win today!
Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: They're going crazy out there.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Just listening to it is making me restless.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Is it just me, or do you always act like I'm some nervous wreck? I'm fine.
Go and run like yourself.
Go and run like yourself.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: …Well, I guess this isn't the first time you've told me to be myself.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: You've always told me to run my own way. Always…

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: You know… why did you let me keep racing?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I was complaining literally every second, not to mention how unfair my manager was to you.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: You even completely disregarded what I wanted at one point. That must've been hard for you.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: But you still let me run… Why?
I promise I'll keep you on the track no matter what.
I promise I'll keep you on the track no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: …Is that it?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Not for me? Or yourself? Or even the fans?
choice_data_list: I knew you wanted to run.
I knew you wanted to run.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Haha… Seriously, you're something else.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: But you know, I'm glad I chose an overbearing pain in the ass for my trainer… I really am.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Oh, wipe that stupid grin off your face.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: You can show me it after the race, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Time to get out there and be me!
